Observability._comment_ServiceName: traceId/spanId/service/level are the mandatory fields on every log entry (observability-standards.md); ServiceName is the 'service' field.

Otlp._comment_Endpoint: OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP/gRPC endpoint. Services never ship traces/logs to Tempo/Loki directly (observability-standards.md).

ConnectionStrings._comment_OfferDatabase: Write-side PostgreSQL - source of truth for Coupon/PricingQuote/PromotionCampaign (database-design.md). Secret in production - supplied via ConnectionStrings__OfferDatabase env var / K8s Secret, never committed.

Mongo._comment_ConnectionString: Read-side MongoDB (sharded in production) - the CQRS query side. Secret in production.
